record.notes: Venice is widely listed as a free API because the consumer product has a free tier and because the token stake lane reads like an allowance. The docs contradict both readings: staking DIEM or VVV requires buying the token first ('Each Diem = $1/day of credits that refresh daily'), and a free account pays per call. The pay-per-request-in-USDC lane needs no account at all, which is the one route here that touches no identity. Recorded paid-only for the API; the consumer free tier is real and is not an API allowance. The one recorded is the better-evidenced.
